C-BASELINE-CLOSURE-FINAL.Summary: Reconcile outstanding GRACE lifecycle records against the current accepted corpus and portal, preserve historical evidence, and establish a verified baseline for the authorised commit, push and publication.

Goals.Goal: Remove obsolete intermediate plans from active work without asserting that their frozen wording, counts or checksums describe the current corpus.
Close the portable export and five-section portal changes with fresh final evidence.
Preserve the current corpus and approved plan history while correcting the missing-command defect through an explicit replacement.

Constraints.Constraint: Authority: on 2026-10-05 the user explicitly requested reconciliation of GRACE closures and a clean commit, push and publication. This spec and plan record that bounded administrative reconciliation and the already authorised verification; no new product scope is introduced.

Do not rewrite approved assertions, tasks or scopes. Superseded records retain their original content except terminal status and explicit replacement metadata. The malformed C-RU-NATURAL-ALIGNMENT plan is retained verbatim as plan.original.xml.txt in its archived bundle; its superseded spec and closeout explain the missing T-007 command and refer to this valid replacement plan.
Historical checksum lists remain evidence of their original edit windows, never refreshed to manufacture a pass. The 636 current source files captured in protected-sources.json must remain unchanged.
The initial draft's proposed reader study is not claimed as completed. Supersession retires that draft; it does not fabricate acceptance evidence.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No further translation, terminology, charter-policy or portal-feature changes. No production publication until local verification, closure and source commit succeed. Corporate Windows SMB acceptance is not implied by Chromium file-URL tests.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All 18 previous active bundles have an explicit terminal disposition and per-bundle closeout, with original plan content and supporting evidence preserved.
Current source comparison, renderer, scaffolding, repeatability, section boundaries and browser checks pass; the portable package passes its direct-file checks.
GRACE lint reports zero errors and no active change remains after this closure itself is applied.
Publication uses the committed complete portal and refreshes the Charter release snapshot from the same source commit; the live package manifest is verified after deployment.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Fresh selected final gates for C-PORTABLE-PORTAL and C-PORTAL-NEIGHBOURS, preservation audit, zero-error final GRACE lint and subsequent live manifest verification.
